title: SAFEMA Tribunal Upholds ₹1.25 Crore PMLA Attachment in BMC ‘Khichdi’ Scam; Rejects Salary and Loan Defence
description: SAFEMA Tribunal upheld PMLA attachment in the alleged BMC Khichdi scam, rejecting salary and loan explanations for receipt of ₹1.25 crore.The post SAFEMA Tribunal Upholds ₹1.25 Crore PMLA Attachment in BMC ‘Khichdi’ Scam; Rejects Salary and Loan Defence appeared first on TaxGuru.
